Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10³, with tick labels at 10¹, 10², and 10³. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. 

The black line, representing “Base”, begins at approximately 64% at a co-occurrence number of 10⁰ and increases to approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 10³. The orange line, representing “MEND”, starts at approximately 68% at 10⁰ and rises to approximately 74% at 10³. The blue line, representing “FT”, begins at approximately 66% at 10⁰ and increases to approximately 73% at 10³. The red line, representing “IKE”, starts at approximately 72% at 10⁰ and declines to approximately 70% at 10³. The green line, representing “ROME”, begins at approximately 74% at 10⁰ and increases to approximately 78% at 10³.
